## Checklist
- [ ] `./scripts/check_static.sh` passes
- [ ] tests for the change (and a golden scenario if a number changed)
- [ ] module `version` bumped if data, views or fields changed
- [ ] `docs/api/` and `docs/api/CHANGELOG.md` updated if the public API changed
- [ ] a line in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] no secrets, no real people's data
